name: nautilus_fins
description: a nautilus of layered fins: one translucent fin per escape step, each brightening to a dark-lined rim and lit as a curved surface, gold beads strung along the set's edge, the shell's heart inked dark, gold to violet
reuses: veil_shards' scooped sheet with a rim
notes: Round one (093): triage group (14), shells and blooms. wallhaven-ey2zv8 (a gold nautilus with layered fins) is the default; three references are palette entries of the same stack: shell_tunnels (wallhaven-odxj5p, orange shell spirals and tunnels: two fins to an escape step, the dark heart lighter, the reference's pale tone), waltz_orbs (waltzing-in-shadows, glossy dark orbs in gold swirl bands: the reference's dark tone, the interior domes in the map's teal) and thorn_whorl (zhgiu1cypaac1, a spiky gold-and-blue spiral: blue fins and gold beads on black).

Nearest mode: glossy_spirals (satin blades along a spiral's arms over a sculpted relief); here there are no blades: each escape step is one fin, a `sheet` on the smooth count at period 1 whose scoop brightens towards its rim (screen) and a second thin sheet multiplied dark along the rim, so the fins overlap like a shell's chambers; a slope `light` on the same count shades the relief (at `rings` 0 its `period` draws nothing, so the fins' curve is the sheets'). Bubble-trap beads (ember_rose's, largest 0.015) are strung along the edge, a de glow multiplied dark inks the lace as the shell's heart, and the interior is a glossy dome (glossy_lobes').

Reachable by one escape loop: no. The fins, relief and dark heart are the frame's loop; the beads are a bubble trap's loop and the dome the `inside` loop, so three loops a sample. The `nf_layered` formulation adds a turned view's fins (a fourth). Seats are a `--spiral` scout (seed 93): almost every one reads as a nautilus at draft size.

Lessons: the palette runs on the inverted smooth count so the far field is the pale shell and the core dark, as in the reference; at the reference's median (0.628) the far field washes towards cream, which is the picture's own key. The lace drew olive mush until the dark-heart glow went to opacity 0.9 at falloff 0.002.

Tone: the median holds (0.60 to 0.62 against 0.628) but p10 misses at every seat (0.24 to 0.38 against 0.012): the reference's 17% black is a shadowed core no spiral seat draws, and the pass cannot pull p10 that far under a median of 0.6. A wider dark-heart falloff (0.006, 0.015), palette gamma 0.5 and 2, and a broad near-set shade (the inverted distance at power 2 to 8) each left it at 0.27 to 0.36. The entries hold: shell_tunnels 2 of 2, waltz_orbs 2 of 2; thorn_whorl misses p90 low (0.44 against 0.60) at both seats.

Explorer cost (093, `style cost --location`, beside another item's work: an upper bound): 30.1 s for the default stack (`nf_layered`'s turned view, a fourth loop, costs more) as WebAssembly on one thread at 1280x800 ss2 at the deeper formulation seat (julia-mandelbrot_45222fc4, maxiter 8,599), under the 5-minute bar.

Matt (2026-11-26): round one 3/5, catalogued at lab tier. Kept nf_layered and nf_glass at seat b, locations nf_loc_29 and nf_loc_03, and shell_tunnels at seat a (scored 3). waltz_orbs kept nothing here (glossy_lobes' version was kept) and thorn_whorl kept nothing in either mode, so it left the library. The mode ships as drawn, its p10 miss accepted: no round two.
